about: Hand-curated venue research for the Haifa International Film Festival, keyed by the code the converter derives from the site's venue label. Not tied to an edition, because a hall outlives a programme. Every figure is {value, source}, or null when nobody could cite it. Coordinates are the exception: none could be geocoded from the research session, so each is marked with the basis it rests on, and the served notes say so.

accessibility.value: Wheelchair spaces at the sides of rows 2-4.

auditorium.notes: Haifa Auditorium, in the Carmel Centre complex. It has 1,139 seats (up to 1,453 in other configurations) on a single rake with no balcony. The festival's own pages give the address as HaNassi 142.

coordinates.basis: approximate: same block as the Auditorium

accessibility.value: Wheelchair spaces in the first row.

rapaport.notes: The (new) Rappaport Hall, in the Rappaport Centre in the same HaNassi 138-142 block as the Auditorium, so the walk between them is close to zero.

coordinates.basis: approximate: same block as the Auditorium

cinematheque.notes: Haifa Cinematheque, in the same HaNassi 138-142 block (another page gives 140). It has two cinemas, but the festival's schedule labels both 'Cinematheque', so no screening is assigned a room and no seat count is known. The research noted wheelchair spaces in row 9 without recording where that came from, so accessibility stays null.

coordinates.basis: approximate: same block as the Auditorium

mirrors-hall.notes: Mirrors Hall inside Beit Hecht, in the same block, used for industry events only. Another page gives HaNassi 138. No seat count found.

tikotin.notes: The Raphael Auditorium of the Tikotin Museum of Japanese Art, a 10-15 minute walk from the Carmel Centre complex. habama.co.il (hall 222) shows a seating map but no seat count.

cinema-reshet-herzl-46.notes: Cinema Reshet, an outdoor screening space in the Hadar neighbourhood, away from the Carmel Centre halls. The festival uses it for three evenings of past festival short films, tickets on site only. The schedule files it under its catch-all Events column; the event pages name it.

accessibility.value: Wheelchair spaces at the ends of row 15.

kriger-carmel-zarfati.notes: Krieger Centre for the Performing Arts, in Carmel Zarfati ('French Carmel'), which is a neighbourhood and not the hall's name. The source gives the capacity as about 500. It is a 15-minute drive from the Carmel Centre, with a festival shuttle.
